page.title: LiteGrip Gripper
page.subtitle: Two-finger adaptive parallel gripper · stroke 0–{{max}} mm

connection.mountMismatch: The record declares {{declared}} but the device is running {{actual}} — check the linkage
connection.noSession: This daemon has no gripper session (not Linux, or started with --no-gripper)
connection.connectHint: Connect the gripper (it shares the arm's CAN bus)

source.label: Calibration
source.templateWarning: This is the SDK's nominal template: it declares the mounting direction and nominal 120 mm geometry and has never been measured on this unit — millimetres are a direction check only.
source.factoryWarning: This is the SDK's bundled factory data: if it is not this gripper, every millimetre and force reading is wrong.
source.missingWarning: No usable calibration: motion is refused. Import a measured calibration, or declare the mounting direction on the settings page.

gate.READY_why: The calibration describes this gripper; every command is available.
gate.TEMPLATE_why: Only the direction is declared: open, close and release are allowed, and millimetre targets are refused (the template geometry is a 120 mm unit's). Import a measured calibration for this unit to restore them.
gate.FACTORY_why: The SDK's bundled factory data is in use: millimetre readings may be offset until this unit is measured. Allow it on the settings page once you accept the risk.
gate.BLOCKED_why: No usable calibration; motion is refused.

zeroGravity.enterTitle: Enter zero gravity: zero torque while energised, the jaws can be pushed by hand
zeroGravity.exitTitle: Leave zero gravity: open, close, grasp or any other move restores position control

writeZero.title: Write zero
writeZero.desc: Make the gripper's current position the motor's zero (write 0xFE). Only the offset changes, not the span, so the existing travel conversion stays valid.
writeZero.needsEnabled: Writing the zero needs the drive enabled, with a status frame received
writeZero.done: Zero written: {{before}} rad before → {{after}} rad read back
writeZero.warning: ⚠ This is written to the motor's flash and is irreversible: only click when the gripper is really where you want zero to be.

settings.title: Gripper and bus
settings.description: Configure the LiteGrip on this CAN interface: channel, CAN ids, travel and calibration file.
settings.needsDisconnect: Disconnect the gripper before changing the channel or ids
settings.importDesc: Load a JSON calibration from the control machine and pin it to this channel.
settings.browseUnavailable: Could not open the file picker: no local program window is running. Type the full path instead.
settings.allowFactoryDesc: If the factory data is not this unit, every millimetre reading is offset; tick only once you have confirmed it.
settings.travelDesc: Per channel: it is the denominator of the mm/rad conversion and has to survive a restart.
